## Change and mathematical scope

**Conditional κ ≥ 0.003661727792**, a gain **>6.25173848e-7 over #7620's authenticated complete raw upper**, under an explicit common whole-private-extent supplier contract **U**. Ten original-clock edits compose the published #7608 902-at-595 stay drop and #7613 902/1091 contact rechart with #7620's fixed 167-CLEAR construction. Complete signed paid jobs fall **110,145→110,111**, with 22,461 productive jobs and surplus 1,424 unchanged; no extra paid MOVE.

**Changed hypothesis:** U must uniformly cover both words' complete private INIT/CLEAR, arbitrary old junk and reachable numerical residuals, atomic return and nonaliasing, within the same finite already-charged tariff. The combined lifetime item is 4,000 ordinary source units per lifetime pair; INIT/CLEAR each receive 32 scalar-service units and the retained normalized 2^20 step coefficient with all original size/precision factors. All storage, tape and other work remain covered by that supplier bound. **U is unimplemented; #7620's original erasure premise is not proved to imply it, and same-original-premise dominance remains unestablished.** The five inherited framework assumptions remain.

One erased row changes: owner 1557 at source 43229/candidate 43223, chart 595, becomes `-e451+e1495` instead of `-e451-3/2e902-3/2e985+e1495`. Twelve owned scalar interfaces change. Full records and all 167 regenerated relation certificates are supplied. These relations do not implement physical erasure.

The offline bundle retains 266 frozen inputs and execution evidence in one new research directory; review can start with PROOF, the ten-edit manifest and the counted native/signed adapters.

Live PRs and #7111/#1166 were checked. [Scoped claim and actual qualification](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19642020). #7621's 1445/1461 courier and 226 re-stop are disjoint and are excluded. The later 173-CLEAR checkpoint mentioned by #7620 is also excluded. No selected-result or existing research file changes.

## Validation

Fresh Linux Python 3.12, assertions enabled, one CPU, 2 GiB and zero swap:

- Paired 1,569-symbol rational replay, independent rank-one certificate, all 167 lifetime identities/COPY guards and owned observations; 13 changed-route pairs with signed phase and 512 forward+512 adjoint columns each.
- Complete native application: **837** affected transport pairs, each 512 forward+adjoint columns, finite physical replay of 77,188 instructions and all 104 ports, retained corruption controls, fresh paired ingredient invoices/ordinary/precision.
- Complete signed application: **3,089 catalogue cases**, assembly, **104 boundary bindings**, **58 outer predicates**, actual 17-call invoice, physical/grid/precision/tape/compiler checks; two stale native results and four stale receipt-binding mutations rejected.
- Fresh source resource branch uses paired fresh native calculations and a reconstructed 17-call source invoice/gate. Its seven checks passed; the source catalogue was not rerun and this branch is not a standalone source-native pass.
- Same-model ordinary: ingredient **863,312,128→863,274,616**; signed **788,917,744→788,882,316**. Signed precision 2430, scalar-service units 44,233,824→44,231,648, elementary tape records 25,413,787,840→25,407,989,888. Both directed price engines support the conservative claim and strict probe 0.003661727792007; ceiling/headroom are retained.

One 40-minute qualification passed in **1774.65s**, peak **1,178,521,600 bytes**, with an empty process group afterward; native 1216.00s, signed 498.37s. Freeze **f30224e5bfbb26c283bad46e599c44450081f0130ac0ff5a70871c0dd85a49a2**. No scientific retry for this candidate.

Artifact integrity passed normal/optimized Python, a fresh read-only copy, missing/empty inventories, missing nested manifests, altered-map and altered-source controls. Metadata-only materialization passed; no second scientific run is inferred. Repository metadata/pins check passed. **Registered VERIFY checks artifact integrity only; hosted scientific replay is not claimed.** A fresh full application requires explicit `reproduce.py --work /tmp/new-work --run`, Linux user systemd and the same bounds; it uses the committed candidate and retained first-gate evidence. Substantial OpenAI Pro/Codex and GPT-6.1-Terra-high assistance; author-side agent reviews are not independent human or proof-kernel acceptance. Apache-2.0.
